topNeed.title: MCP Server Reliability and Configuration Issues
topNeed.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration, including connection failures, authentication problems with OAuth callbacks, and context length constraints when many servers are configured. These issues span different execution environments like remote triggers, scheduled agents, and Windows platforms, suggesting systemic gaps in MCP connectivity, error handling, and configuration management that need to be addressed for stable MCP server operations.
topNeed.representative_need: Add agent-accessible diagnostic tool for programmatic config validation
sample_titles: Add agent-accessible diagnostic tool for programmatic config validation
Add option to always persist MCP tool results to file regardless of size
Add option to prevent parent directory .mcp.json config inheritance for isolated MCP server configuration

risingNeed.title: TUI Terminal State and Input Handling Fixes
risingNeed.summary: Users are experiencing various terminal interface issues including state corruption when spawning external editors, unresponsive input during multi-agent execution, improper screen clearing, and missing scrollback/history display. These problems stem from inadequate handling of terminal protocols (kitty keyboard, mouse tracking), escape sequence leaks, and scroll behavior during different interaction phases. Fixing these issues will ensure a more reliable and consistent terminal user experience.
risingNeed.representative_need: Add configurable TUI scrollback buffer size for conversation history
sample_titles: Add configurable TUI scrollback buffer size for conversation history
Add configurable companion settings for bubble duration and language
Add configuration option to disable Grime companion UI element

clusters.title: CLI Session Management and UX Improvements
clusters.summary: These issues request improvements to the CLI experience including better session management (resuming sessions via --resume flag, programmatic session renaming, fixing Remote Control session visibility), enhanced output (immediate status line rendering, streaming plain-text for CI/CD, per-request token reporting), and fixes for common problems like hanging behavior with large files, token limit handling, and command recognition issues. Users want a more reliable and informative CLI that handles edge cases gracefully.
clusters.representative_need: Add --cwd flag support to CLI
sample_titles: Add --cwd flag support to CLI
Add XP progression and personality evolution to the buddy companion system based on user usage patterns
Add a flag to auto-accept the development channels confirmation dialog

clusters.title: Plugin System Management and Reliability
clusters.summary: Users want a more robust plugin system with proper installation, uninstallation, and update workflows. Key improvements include support for external plugin sources via remote URLs, better configuration for local development overrides, and fixes for plugin hook environment variables, marketplace validation, and skill resolution state after reloading.
clusters.representative_need: Add a way to override managed plugins during local development
sample_titles: Add a way to override managed plugins during local development
Add version column to /plugin list command output
Ensure CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT environment variable is always set when invoking plugin hooks

clusters.title: Bug Fixes and Feature Enhancements
clusters.summary: Users are reporting various bugs and requesting improvements across multiple areas including error handling reliability, platform-specific fixes for Windows and Android, configuration flexibility, and UI/UX refinements. These issues range from critical problems like silent crashes and connection failures to minor but important enhancements like input focus behavior and navigation improvements.
clusters.representative_need: Add ability to view logs and output for completed remote trigger runs in the web UI
sample_titles: Add ability to view logs and output for completed remote trigger runs in the web UI
Add day-view navigation from trip/chat views with easy back button
Add encoding parameter to Read/Edit tools for handling non-UTF-8 encoded files

clusters.title: Expand Hook System Functionality and Fix Hook Behaviors
clusters.summary: Users are requesting expanded hook capabilities including new lifecycle events (TeamCreated/TeamDeleted, companion reactions), improved configuration options for marketplace hooks and Plan Mode notifications, and bash syntax support. Additionally, several bugs need fixing where hooks fail to fire in specific scenarios like Desktop App tool execution and Agent-spawned teammates, plus documentation gaps around format-on-save behavior.
clusters.representative_need: Add TeamCreated and TeamDeleted hook events for Agent Teams lifecycle management
sample_titles: Add TeamCreated and TeamDeleted hook events for Agent Teams lifecycle management
Add option to allow plugin hooks from trusted marketplaces when using allowManagedHooksOnly mode
Document format-on-save hook behavior for consecutive edits, including the v2.1.90 fix for File content has changed errors

clusters.title: Authentication and subscription reliability fixes
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple authentication and subscription verification issues across platforms, including broken auto-mode for Max subscribers, session handling failures on Windows/macOS, OAuth token invalidation problems for plugins, and platform-specific bugs with the MCP server and rate limit refresh. These issues prevent reliable authentication and subscription status detection across different environments.
clusters.representative_need: Add remote control authentication support for enterprise plans using web sessions
sample_titles: Add remote control authentication support for enterprise plans using web sessions
Add remote session management for Claude Code to allow users to view and revoke authenticated sessions across devices
Fix ERR_BAD_REQUEST error on startup so authorization menu appears

clusters.title: Permission System Reliability and Security Fixes
clusters.summary: Users want fixes for multiple permission system issues including bypassPermissions mode edge cases on Windows, silent behavior degradation, and security vulnerabilities in shell command parsing. These include proper UNC path handling, complete prompt suppression when configured, strengthened security checks for subshells and quoting, and a more extensible JSON Schema-based permission rule system with clearer documentation.
clusters.representative_need: Document that explicit user prohibitions override default allowed actions in auto mode
sample_titles: Document that explicit user prohibitions override default allowed actions in auto mode
Fix --dangerously-skip-permissions to auto-approve file reads from ~/.claude/skills/ directory when copying into workspace
Fix brace expansion security check to respect shell quoting context

clusters.title: Model Response Quality and Instruction Following
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing significant quality degradation in AI model outputs, including hallucinations, incorrect tool selection (using Write instead of Edit causing silent data loss), and failures to accurately follow instructions. These issues undermine trust in the system, especially as degradation worsens with context compression or large contexts. Users need consistent, reliable output that matches the expected quality level.
clusters.representative_need: Fix corrupted or nonsensical Traditional Chinese text generation
sample_titles: Fix corrupted or nonsensical Traditional Chinese text generation
Fix degraded reasoning and execution quality within sessions
Fix instruction following so Claude accurately follows user requests without making incorrect assumptions or modifying unintended files

clusters.title: Background Agent Lifecycle and Reliability Management
clusters.summary: Users need better control and visibility over background agents, including the ability to stop agents on demand, receive real-time completion notifications, and have automatic recovery mechanisms when agents stall or encounter issues like context exhaustion. These improvements would make long-running background agent sessions more reliable and easier to manage.
clusters.representative_need: Add automatic continuation/resumption mechanism when Claude Code or Teammates stall or become unresponsive
sample_titles: Add automatic continuation/resumption mechanism when Claude Code or Teammates stall or become unresponsive
Add pre-emptive context rotation to prevent context exhaustion in long-running agent sessions
Batch multiple pending background task completions into a single response instead of processing them individually

clusters.title: Fix desktop app stability and reliability issues
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing critical bugs in the desktop application including UI rendering failures, excessive latency, permission issues preventing project access, and silent failures from corrupted state. These issues undermine trust in the desktop client and need to be addressed to provide a reliable development experience.
clusters.representative_need: Add animated mascot companion to desktop app
sample_titles: Add animated mascot companion to desktop app
Fix Claude Code Desktop sandbox/permission issue preventing local project access
Fix SSH remote session UI rendering to display responses instead of resetting to blank

clusters.title: Fix Cowork VM workspace reliability issues on Windows
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues with Cowork VM workspaces, including service startup failures, connection timeouts, session management problems, and virtualization detection failures on Windows. These issues span core functionality like FUSE cache coherency, rate limit state management, session deletion behavior, and guest kernel initialization that prevent consistent, reliable operation of virtual workspace environments.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Cowork VM guest connection timeout on Windows ARM64 (Snapdragon) — Linux guest kernel never initializes after plan9 shares are added
sample_titles: Fix Cowork VM guest connection timeout on Windows ARM64 (Snapdragon) — Linux guest kernel never initializes after plan9 shares are added
Fix Cowork virtualization detection failure on Windows 11 when Hyper-V and related features are properly enabled
Fix Delete Cowork VM Sessions to only delete session data, not projects, configurations, and other user data

clusters.title: Configuration and Settings Management Improvements
clusters.summary: Users want better control over Claude Code's configuration through settings.json and environment variables, including conversation retention, context compaction, companion customization, and model routing. Several issues address bugs where configuration changes aren't properly respected—like PATH environment variables, mode switching, and auto-compact settings—indicating inconsistent configuration application across the application.
clusters.representative_need: Add configurable context compaction settings with model-aware thresholds and aggressiveness control for large context windows
sample_titles: Add configurable context compaction settings with model-aware thresholds and aggressiveness control for large context windows
Add configurable context window indicator visibility threshold for VS Code chat view
Add configurable conversation history retention settings

clusters.title: Excessive API token consumption and tracking issues
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing excessive token consumption across multiple scenarios including reading large files, simple interactions, and failing requests. They also report discrepancies between rate limit error messages and usage statistics, making it difficult to track actual resource consumption. These issues lead to unexpected costs and poor visibility into token usage patterns.
clusters.representative_need: Fix excessive API token consumption caused by failing requests
sample_titles: Fix excessive API token consumption caused by failing requests
Fix rate limit and /usage synchronization discrepancy - usage stats show 0% while rate limit is triggered, and reset times don't match between error message and /usage command
Reduce excessive token consumption for simple interactions

clusters.title: Companion visual customization and UI fixes
clusters.summary: Users want improved visual customization options for their companion, including selectable avatar appearances with presets and custom images, as well as companion pet selection with multiple character options. Additionally, there is a bug where duplicate assistant message blocks appear during rapid message sending that needs to be fixed.
clusters.representative_need: Add customizable Companion avatar/appearance options with built-in presets and custom image support
sample_titles: Add customizable Companion avatar/appearance options with built-in presets and custom image support
Add customizable companion pet selection with multiple character options
Fix duplicate assistant message blocks appearing in conversation view during rapid message sending

clusters.title: Resource Management and Memory Optimization
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing crashes and excessive resource consumption during extended sessions. They want improved caching strategies to reduce token usage, automatic cleanup of temporary files, and configurable controls for context management to prevent memory issues while preserving session state.
clusters.representative_need: Add notification and user-configurable controls for silent context compaction mechanisms
sample_titles: Add notification and user-configurable controls for silent context compaction mechanisms
Fix V8 OOM crash in desktop renderer during extended sessions
Fix excessive token consumption from re-reading chat history on every prompt instead of using cache

clusters.title: VS Code extension improvements and editor UX fixes
clusters.summary: Users are requesting various quality-of-life improvements for the VS Code extension, including better file path visibility in approval dialogs, local worktree/cloud mode toggles, hunk-level diff review, and clipboard support for references. Additionally, multiple UI/UX bugs are affecting the editor experience, such as timer accumulation on collapsible sections, editor focus jumping issues, temp file deletion problems, and session restoration failures after streaming. These changes aim to make the extension more reliable and aligned with modern IDE conventions like Cursor.
clusters.representative_need: Add copy-to-clipboard command for at-mention references in VSCode extension
sample_titles: Add copy-to-clipboard command for at-mention references in VSCode extension
Add hunk-level diff review with selective accept/reject/edit for VSCode extension
Add local worktree and cloud mode toggle options to VS Code extension similar to Cursor IDE

clusters.title: API reliability and error handling improvements
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing various API reliability issues including spurious rate limit errors, excessive API consumption from retry loops, and signature errors. They want improved client-side validation to prevent oversized data from reaching the API and more robust error handling to ensure stable, predictable API interactions.
clusters.representative_need: Add client-side image downscaling to prevent oversized images from reaching the API and breaking session state
sample_titles: Add client-side image downscaling to prevent oversized images from reaching the API and breaking session state
Fix Invalid signature error in thinking block when making API requests
Fix excessive API usage consumption caused by rapid retry loops or polling without backoff

clusters.title: Fix IDE integration issues across platforms
clusters.summary: These issues address bugs and improvements for cross-platform IDE integration, particularly in WSL and Windows environments. Users experience crashes, connection failures, and path format mismatches when using VS Code and JetBrains plugins across different platforms. A new setting for diff viewing in VS Code's side panel would also improve the development workflow.
clusters.representative_need: Add setting to open file edit diffs in VS Code side panel instead of main editor tabs
sample_titles: Add setting to open file edit diffs in VS Code side panel instead of main editor tabs
Fix WebSocket connection dropping immediately in JetBrains plugin on Windows
Fix navigator global access that causes VS Code extension host crash on WSL2

clusters.title: Improve Bash tool reliability and robustness
clusters.summary: Users are reporting several reliability issues with the Bash tool including crashes when encountering certain redirects, orphaned background processes from unhandled termination signals, inconsistent approval persistence for compound commands, and unclear error messages for operations like disk space issues. They want the Bash tool to handle these edge cases gracefully without crashing and with clear user feedback.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Bash tool crash when encountering 2>&1 redirects instead of proper error handling or approval prompt
sample_titles: Fix Bash tool crash when encountering 2>&1 redirects instead of proper error handling or approval prompt
Fix approval persistence for compound Bash commands joined with &&
Improve error messaging when Bash tool operations fail due to insufficient /tmp disk space

clusters.title: Fix Read and Bash Tool Bugs
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues with the Read and Bash tools that disrupt development workflows. These include file path handling failures with Unicode characters, environment PATH inheritance problems preventing Homebrew executable discovery, unexpected file reversion after test execution, and error handling that corrupts session state. Fixing these bugs will restore developer trust and ensure consistent tool behavior.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Read tool to correctly handle file paths containing Unicode characters, specifically smart apostrophes (U+2019)
sample_titles: Fix Read tool to correctly handle file paths containing Unicode characters, specifically smart apostrophes (U+2019)
Fix Read tool to inherit PATH from user environment to find Homebrew-installed executables
Fix silent file reversion after Bash execution of test runners

clusters.title: StatusLine JSON Payload Improvements
clusters.summary: These issues relate to improving the statusLine JSON payload functionality. Users want fixes for stale update notifications when resuming sessions post-upgrade, and want additional information like effort level exposed in the JSON payload. These enhancements improve the integration capabilities for developers using the tool programmatically.
clusters.representative_need: Expose effort level in statusLine JSON payload
sample_titles: Expose effort level in statusLine JSON payload
Fix stale update notification shown after resuming a session post-upgrade

clusters.title: Issues related to documentation
clusters.summary: 6 issues: Add PowerShell-specific permission-check documentation to explain security model, background job behavior, and parse-failure handling; Document the rate-limit options dialog that appears when users hit their usage limit; Document prompt cache behavior for resumed sessions with MCP servers, deferred tools, and custom agents
clusters.representative_need: Add PowerShell-specific permission-check documentation to explain security model, background job behavior, and parse-failure handling
sample_titles: Add PowerShell-specific permission-check documentation to explain security model, background job behavior, and parse-failure handling
Add documentation for /powerup slash command to built-in commands reference and interactive-mode page
Document CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE environment variable

clusters.title: Fix skills loading from nested subdirectories
clusters.summary: Users want project-level skills to load correctly from nested .claude/skills/ subdirectories. Currently, skills in nested directories either fail to load or get registered twice, resulting in duplicate entries in the slash command autocomplete menu and a poor developer experience.
clusters.representative_need: Fix project-level skills loading from nested .claude/skills/ subdirectories
sample_titles: Fix project-level skills loading from nested .claude/skills/ subdirectories
Fix skills being registered/loaded twice, causing duplicate entries in the slash command autocomplete menu

clusters.title: Fix context window size handling for auto-compaction
clusters.summary: Users need the system to properly respect actual model context window sizes instead of using hardcoded defaults for auto-compaction thresholds. Additionally, a regression has reduced context window capacity from 1M to 200K tokens, significantly impacting the ability to work with larger contexts. These issues affect functionality when using models with varying context window capabilities.
clusters.representative_need: Fix auto-compaction threshold to calculate based on actual model context window size rather than a hardcoded default
sample_titles: Fix auto-compaction threshold to calculate based on actual model context window size rather than a hardcoded default
Fix unexpected context window regression from 1M to 200K tokens

clusters.title: Improve operational reliability and validation safeguards
clusters.summary: Users need the agent to reliably execute all agreed-upon steps in multi-step plans without silently dropping operations, and they want validation safeguards to prevent costly configuration errors with paid external APIs. Both issues address the need for the system to operate predictably and prevent errors that could result in unexpected costs or incomplete work.
clusters.representative_need: Add validation safeguards for paid external API operations to prevent costly configuration errors
sample_titles: Add validation safeguards for paid external API operations to prevent costly configuration errors
Fix agent silently dropping agreed-upon operational steps from multi-step plans

clusters.title: Improve installation and upgrade experience
clusters.summary: Users want their customizations and environment configurations to persist through installation and upgrade processes. Specifically, they need the Windows installer to automatically configure PATH for .local\bin and preserve buddy customizations across versions. This reduces friction when setting up or updating the tool.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Windows installer to automatically add .local\bin to user PATH after installation
sample_titles: Fix Windows installer to automatically add .local\bin to user PATH after installation
Preserve user buddy customization across installation and upgrade processes

clusters.title: Enhanced git worktree and multi-repo support
clusters.summary: Users want Claude Code to handle edge cases when working with git repositories more gracefully. This includes preserving valid characters like '/' in branch names when creating worktrees (while only sanitizing directory-unsafe characters), and loading configuration files like CLAUDE.md from target repositories during cross-repo operations. These improvements would make working with monorepos and complex git setups more reliable.
clusters.representative_need: Load CLAUDE.md from target repos when modifying files across git repository boundaries
sample_titles: Load CLAUDE.md from target repos when modifying files across git repository boundaries
Preserve '/' in branch names when creating worktrees (only sanitize directory names)

clusters.title: Improve trust and safety mechanisms
clusters.summary: Users want the application to handle trust and safety more intelligently. This includes restricting dangerous code execution from project-level settings, correctly parsing git commands with special syntax, and eliminating excessive confirmation prompts that create friction without meaningfully improving security.
clusters.representative_need: Fix excessive trust confirmation prompts on every app launch
sample_titles: Fix excessive trust confirmation prompts on every app launch
Fix permission checker to correctly detect git commands with heredoc/subshell syntax in commit messages
Restrict apiKeyHelper execution to user-level config or add explicit consent/warning to prevent arbitrary code execution from project-level settings

clusters.title: Fix clipboard operations across environments and locales
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing issues with clipboard functionality in terminal environments. One issue involves Korean text corruption during copy operations with the new renderer, while another relates to clipboard image pasting in WSL2 environments. These fixes aim to improve clipboard reliability across different system configurations and locales.
clusters.representative_need: Add WSL2 detection with PowerShell fallback for clipboard image pasting
sample_titles: Add WSL2 detection with PowerShell fallback for clipboard image pasting
Fix Korean text corruption when copying with the new renderer enabled

clusters.title: Background process management and PATH preservation
clusters.summary: Users want to run preview dev servers as background processes without spawning visible terminal windows on Windows, and ensure PATH environment variables are preserved when spawning child processes. This improves the development workflow by reducing window clutter and preventing tools from failing due to missing PATH configurations.
clusters.representative_need: Preserve PATH environment variable in spawned processes to avoid breaking tools that look up executables via PATH
sample_titles: Preserve PATH environment variable in spawned processes to avoid breaking tools that look up executables via PATH
Run preview dev server as background process without spawning visible terminal window on Windows

clusters.title: Add internationalization and localization support
clusters.summary: Users want the application to support multiple languages, both for the main UI text and for companion features like Buddy comments and Baublekin. This includes adding Russian language support and a general i18n framework to enable future language additions. This is important for non-English speaking users and broader international adoption.
clusters.representative_need: Add Russian language support for Baublekin companion
sample_titles: Add Russian language support for Baublekin companion
Add i18n/localization support for Claude Code UI text to support multiple languages
Add localization support for Buddy companion comments

clusters.title: Improve keyboard bindings and input handling
clusters.summary: Users want more flexible and reliable keyboard bindings across platforms, including configurable shortcuts, proper international keyboard support, correct custom binding override behavior, and improved keybinding file management. These improvements would enhance the developer experience for users who rely on keyboard-driven workflows.
clusters.representative_need: Add keyboard shortcut to submit messages in Code mode on Android
sample_titles: Add keyboard shortcut to submit messages in Code mode on Android
Fix /keybindings command to only write the keybindings.json file when user actually saves changes
Fix @-sign input handling on Nordic keyboard layouts using AltGr+2

topNeed.title: Improve CLI Stability, Error Handling, and Graceful Recovery
topNeed.summary: Users want to resolve CLI instability issues including startup latency, infinite hangs, crashes, and unhandled network errors to ensure uninterrupted workflows. They also request improved error messaging, graceful timeouts, and session-level plugin reloading to minimize context drain and manual restarts. Addressing these pain points will deliver a more robust, predictable, and efficient command-line experience.

clusters.title: Enhance Core Stability, State Management, and Execution Reliability
clusters.summary: Users are requesting critical fixes for resource leaks, session data loss, platform-specific execution failures, and inaccurate usage tracking, alongside enhancements for conversation search and desktop automation. They require robust API retry logic and proper path resolution to ensure consistent, uninterrupted agent operation. Addressing these issues will prevent disruptive crashes and significantly improve the platform's overall reliability.
clusters.representative_need: Add native computer use tools for desktop GUI automation
sample_titles: Add native computer use tools for desktop GUI automation
Fix inaccurate tracking and consumption of the daily usage limit quota

clusters.title: Fix UI Layout Overlaps and Content Rendering Bugs
clusters.summary: Users are reporting multiple interface display issues, including overlapping search controls, missing thread titles, and broken plugin metadata rendering. Addressing these visual inconsistencies will improve the overall polish, readability, and usability of the application.
clusters.representative_need: Fix UI containment and metadata rendering for local plugin skills
sample_titles: Fix UI containment and metadata rendering for local plugin skills
Fix in-app search bar UI overlap with native window controls
Preserve and display custom thread titles in archived thread lists

clusters.title: Cross-platform application stability and interface customization
clusters.summary: Users are encountering critical execution blocks, launch freezes, and rigid layout constraints across Windows and macOS environments. They need reliable bundled tool execution, stable startup processes, and adjustable chat widths to ensure a smooth and adaptable user experience.
clusters.representative_need: Fix bundled ripgrep (rg.exe) execution on Windows due to folder permission restrictions
sample_titles: Fix bundled ripgrep (rg.exe) execution on Windows due to folder permission restrictions
Fix system-wide process hangs and terminal freezes during macOS app launch
Support adjustable chat content width in the app UI

clusters.title: Fix expiration handling and thread pagination display issues
clusters.summary: Users are requesting fixes for how promotional tips expire and how threads are paginated and sorted. Addressing these bugs will prevent outdated content from persisting and ensure all relevant sessions are accurately displayed without silent omissions.
clusters.representative_need: Fix expiration handling for TUI promotional tips
sample_titles: Fix expiration handling for TUI promotional tips
Fix thread pagination to prevent silent session omission when sorting by UpdatedAt
